register.labelZh: TOSS 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: toss ideas around 或 about 可以描述大家在選擇方案前,非正式地提出並討論不同構思。；toss something away 表示把某物丟掉;toss something aside 則表示把某物隨手丟到一旁,或不再理會它。；toss a drink back 表示迅速喝下飲品;toss a piece of writing off 則表示很快而且看似毫不費力地完成寫作。；toss for something、toss somebody for something 和 toss up 可以描述以擲硬幣決定誰先開始或得到某物。
register.summaryEn: Toss ideas around or about helps you describe an informal discussion before people choose a plan. Toss something away shows that it is thrown out, while toss something aside shows that it is quickly put to one side or no longer considered. Toss a drink back describes drinking it quickly. Toss a piece of writing off describes producing it quickly and with little apparent effort. Toss for something, toss somebody for something and toss up help you describe deciding who goes first or receives something.
